video_title: BTS LOOK INTO TRAE YOUNG'S OFF-SEASON HEADING INTO YEAR 9 | DOC 8: THE GET BACK

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the importance of training with Brandon Payne
quotes.excerpt: I wanted to make sure that when I came back to playing, I was in the best shape
quotes.quote: Obviously this summer I wanted to make sure that when I came back to playing, I was in the best shape that I could possibly be in. When I played and the season started, I was ready. For me, it was important to work out with BP, Brandon Payne, basically this whole summer. Being with BP, who is one of the best in the game, trained probably the best point guard who's done it, very focused on shooting and conditioning and what I wanted to get better at this summer. It was a no-brainer to be able to seek out advice from him and to seek out training from him all summer.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Payne
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Payne explains the structure of Trae Young's drill
quotes.excerpt: After the first four slides, we're going to get rid of one of the basketballs

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Payne
text_blocks.text: After the first four slides, we're going to get rid of one of the basketballs. So we're going to deload just a little bit, okay? So you go four slides, two balls, then we're going to get rid of one and we'll finish the last five slides with one basketball, okay?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: Got you, bet. Here we go.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on why he chose to train with Brandon Payne
quotes.excerpt: I knew it wasn't going to be easy and that's the reason why I wanted to keep him around
quotes.quote: To get through a lot of the drills and get through it easy, especially at the beginning, I knew it wasn't going to be easy and that's the reason why I wanted to keep him around and bring him around this summer. Because of how challenging he is and how much he challenges your mind and the conditioning and everything.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the mental challenge of Brandon Payne's drills
quotes.excerpt: You have those moments where you're mad at yourself and you're frustrated and you're confused
quotes.quote: You have those moments where you're mad at yourself and you're frustrated and you're confused on why he comes up with some of these drills and don't understand until you go home and you're sitting there relaxing and you got to think about what the drills were we're doing. Or after he explains it, why you're doing this. And as you're catching your breath, he's explaining things. That's very important, a reason why he is where he is and he's very successful, so the best players work with him.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on his early professional training with Travelle Gaines
quotes.excerpt: My first real introduction into like being a pro was like with Travelle
quotes.quote: My first real introduction into being a pro was with Travelle. I remember going to LA for my awards in college and it was after the season, right after the tournament. Obviously I hadn't announced yet that I was going to the league, but I had made plans with being with Travelle and training. After the event, I went straight to train.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the professional habits instilled by Travelle Gaines
quotes.excerpt: Being 19 like him, teaching me how to be a pro as far as the training aspect
quotes.quote: Being 19 like him, teaching me how to be a pro as far as the training aspect and the daily habits you have to build like your rookie year, the two-a-days, and coming in early and lifting and getting your work in and the eating habits that you have to have to be able to maintain an 82-game season. He was kind of the first person I was around that had been around a lot of pros and athletes that I kind of trust and I've just always always been around him since and he's he's kind of helped me stay healthy during the course of my career.

quotes.speaker: Will Dawkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Will Dawkins on Trae Young's impact on the Wizards organization
quotes.excerpt: Since the moment that Trae arrived, he really established himself as the person and the player
quotes.quote: Since the moment that Trae arrived, he really established himself as the person and the player that we've known him to be. He got right to work getting to know his teammates, getting to know his coaches, and really integrating himself into the DMV community. On and off the court, he's always been a connector. You don't become third all-time in assists per game without having a connective spirit or having a connective tissue. As a player, he's got a proven track record of just producing and making his teammates better. That's why we targeted him, that's why we traded for him, and that's ultimately why we worked to resign him.

quotes.speaker: Kyshawn George
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyshawn George on Trae Young's maturity as a young player
quotes.excerpt: It's not normal to have this type of maturity level from a lot of the young guys
quotes.quote: I've been around a lot of young guys and it's not normal to have this type of maturity level from a lot of the young guys too. Coming into the league as a young player, you want to it's easy and very natural to get caught up on yourself.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the importance of role acceptance for young players
quotes.excerpt: As young players and rookie, the second year guys, it's very important to play your role
quotes.quote: As young players and rookie, the second year guys, it's very important to play your role and understand that it's not easy to to get to the playoffs and get get far. I think I just love the maturity we have with these young guys and it's going to show.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the mental benefits of training on the dunes
quotes.excerpt: Working on the dunes in LA, I really started with Travelle too, my rookie year
quotes.quote: Working on the dunes in LA, I really started with Travelle too, my rookie year, every Saturday in the summer time when I'm in LA. It's something that has made me very focused while I'm out there in LA. It keeps me very grounded and it keeps me like pushing myself. It keeps me motivated. I want to get to the sand dunes every Saturday. It's very fun, it's very tough, and not something I've had since I was a rookie. I've done it every Saturday every year I'm in LA.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the internal competition of training on the dunes
quotes.excerpt: It's not even competing with the person to the left or right of you, it's like competing with yourself
quotes.quote: There's a lot of reasons why I love going to the dunes. I think obviously the work you put in, but the the energy, the vibe, the setting, the scene. Being able to compete and get to the top of the hill. It's not even competing with the person to the left or right of you, it's like competing with yourself and getting to the top of the hill and getting up there and reaching the top and then sitting there and looking out and seeing the water and just feeling the the breeze from the air, it's like you feel like you accomplished something there. It wasn't easy to accomplish it, nobody made you accomplish it, nobody made you finish and push through, like you did it yourself and I think that's something that's good to have in your mind.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on building a new identity for the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: I'm definitely focused on our identity and making sure that the Wizards is a brand you look at
quotes.quote: I'm definitely focused on our identity and making sure that the Wizards is a brand you look at in a positive way. You want the Wizards to have that same type of feeling and DC is a basketball city at heart with a bunch of other great sports around it. So yeah, for me, I just want the culture to be back to what it is and what it used to be. Yeah, you definitely see the energy shifting, you definitely feel the vibe and everything and everything shifting around the city, but it's not just because of me. It's because of this whole team, this whole organization and what they've been building these last few years. This is just a great opportunity for me and everybody around me, like my teammates, and just to take advantage of it and because if we win the city, the city's going to be up.
